items.label: SUMMER GAMES II
items.why: The boot program: a BASIC line (SYS 2061) that copies itself to $02A7 and points the system vectors at $02C4, so LOAD alone starts it; it loads COPYRIGHT 1985 to $C000 and jumps there.

items.label: COPYRIGHT 1985
items.why: On side 1, the fast loader and its drive code, which the boot program starts at $C000; it moves the resident loader to $0800-$0FFF (part resident, which holds most of these bytes). On side 2, a stub that asks for side 1 (INSERT SUMMER GAMES II SIDE 1 THEN PRESS JOYSTICK BUTTON) and loads side 1's copy.

items.label: EPYX
items.why: An empty file, two bytes of load address and nothing else, that puts EPYX in the directory listing beside the title and the copyright; nothing loads it.
The title picture and its code, packed: record 3 unpacks it to $4000-$A7E7 and starts it at $9F40.
The opening ceremony, packed: record 1 unpacks it to $4000-$7F82 and starts it at $7600.
The menu, packed: the loader's file table (record 0) unpacks it to $0F00-$3FFF and starts it there. Side 2 carries a copy that differs only in its last byte, so the menu loads from either side.
Triple Jump, packed: record 4 unpacks it to $4000-$F7FF and starts it at $9E00.
Rowing, packed: record 5 unpacks it to $4C00-$A81C and starts it at $9400.
Javelin, packed: record 6 unpacks it to $4000-$CFF7 and starts it at $7B00.
Equestrian, packed: record 7 unpacks it to $1C00-$CD68 and starts it at $1C00.
The closing ceremony, packed: record 2 unpacks it to $1000-$D00F and starts it at $1000.

items.label: X
items.why: Cycling, packed: record 10 unpacks it to $4C00-$CFFF and starts it at $9400.

items.label: Y
items.why: Kayaking, packed: record 11 unpacks it to $4000-$FB57 and starts it at $7000.

items.label: Z
items.why: The first Summer Games' swimming events, packed: records 17 and 18 both unpack it to $1000-$BEFF, entered at $17D0 for the Freestyle Relay and $17D3 for the 100 metres; the code copies its upper half to $E000 when it starts.
